question.problem: Calculate the volume of the parallelepiped spanned by $\overset{\to }{AB},$ $\overset{\to }{AC}$ and $\overset{\to }{AD},$ given the points $A(8,0,5),$ $B(8,-3,3),$ $C(5,2,5),$ and $D(7,-1,4).$
question.worked_solution:
First, we find the displacement vectors $\overset{\to }{AB},$ $\overset{\to }{AC},$ and $\overset{\to }{AD}$ that span the parallelepiped:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{AB} & =b-a \\  & =(8i-3j+3k)-(8i+5k) \\  & =-3j-2k \\  & =⟨0,-3,-2⟩ \\ \overset{\to }{AC} & =c-a \\  & =(5i+2j+5k)-(8i+5k) \\  & =-3i+2j \\  & =⟨-3,2,0⟩ \\ \overset{\to }{AD} & =d-a \\  & =(7i-j+4k)-(8i+5k) \\  & =-i-j-k \\  & =⟨-1,-1,-1⟩\end{aligned}
$$

Now, to find the volume of the parallelepiped, we need to take the absolute value of the triple product of the above vectors.

Computing the triple product, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{AB}\cdot (\overset{\to }{AC}\times \overset{\to }{AD}) & =|\begin{aligned}0 & -3 & -2 \\ -3 & 2 & 0 \\ -1 & -1 & -1\end{aligned}| \\  & =0\cdot |\begin{aligned}2 & 0 \\ -1 & -1\end{aligned}|-(-3)\cdot |\begin{aligned}-3 & 0 \\ -1 & -1\end{aligned}|+(-2)\cdot |\begin{aligned}-3 & 2 \\ -1 & -1\end{aligned}| \\  & =0+3((-3)\cdot (-1)-(-1)\cdot 0)-2((-3)\cdot (-1)-(-1)\cdot 2) \\  & =9-10 \\  & =-1.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the volume of the corresponding parallelepiped spanned by $\overset{\to }{AB},$ $\overset{\to }{AC},$ and $\overset{\to }{AD}$ is

$$
V=|-1|=1.
$$
